local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD
local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD
local viewport=safe.AbsoluteSize
assert(viewport.X>=280 and viewport.Y>=180,'rendered safe viewport unavailable or degenerate')
assert(math.abs((g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveViewportWidth') or 0)-viewport.X)<=1 and math.abs((g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveViewportHeight') or 0)-viewport.Y)<=1,'responsive viewport disagrees with rendered safe area')
-- BEGIN MEASURED MOBILE ASSERTIONS
local function inside(x,parent)
 local p,s,q,t=x.AbsolutePosition,x.AbsoluteSize,parent.AbsolutePosition,parent.AbsoluteSize
 assert(s.X>0 and s.Y>0 and p.X>=q.X-1 and p.Y>=q.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=q.X+t.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=q.Y+t.Y+1,'outside bounds: '..x.Name)
end
local function renderedFloor(x)
 local scale=1 local n=x
 while n do
  for _,child in ipairs(n:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA('UIScale') then scale*=child.Scale end end
  n=n.Parent
 end
 local size=x.TextSize
 if x.TextScaled then local limit=x:FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint') assert(limit,'unbounded scaled text: '..x.Name) size=limit.MinTextSize end
 return size*scale
end
local function readable(x,floor)
 assert(x and x.Visible and x.Text~='','missing readable text')
 assert(renderedFloor(x)>=floor-0.01,'small rendered text: '..x.Name)
 assert(x.TextFits==true,'text does not fit: '..x.Name)
 local b,s=x.TextBounds,x.AbsoluteSize
 assert(b.X>0 and b.Y>0 and b.X<=s.X+1 and b.Y<=s.Y+1,'rendered text bounds overflow: '..x.Name)
end
local function touch(x,floor)
 assert(math.min(x.AbsoluteSize.X,x.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=floor-0.01,'small rendered target: '..x.Name)
end
-- END MEASURED MOBILE ASSERTIONS
local function shown(x)
 local n=x
 while n and n~=g do if n:IsA('GuiObject') and not n.Visible then return false end n=n.Parent end
 return true
end

a:Invoke('OpenInventory')
a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','All')
a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','')
a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All')
task.wait(.4)
local root=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory
local window=root.InventoryWindow
inside(g.GameMenu,safe) inside(window,g.GameMenu)
assert(math.abs(window.AbsoluteSize.X-g.GameMenu.AbsoluteSize.X)<=1 and math.abs(window.AbsoluteSize.Y-g.GameMenu.AbsoluteSize.Y)<=1,'inventory applies duplicate safe inset')
local grid=window.InventoryBody.InventoryGridPane.InventoryGrid
inside(grid,window)
local cards={}
for _,card in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
 if card:IsA('GuiButton') and card.Visible and card:GetAttribute('InventoryKey') then
  touch(card,44) local x=card:FindFirstChild('ItemName') readable(x,14) inside(x,card)
  local rarity=card:FindFirstChild('ItemRarity') readable(rarity,12) inside(rarity,card)
  assert(card.AbsoluteSize.Y>=88 and card.AbsoluteSize.Y<=96,'inventory row height')
  table.insert(cards,card)
 end
end
assert(#cards>0,'inventory fixture has no cards')
for _,x in ipairs(window:GetDescendants()) do if x:IsA('GuiButton') and shown(x) then touch(x,44) end end
local first=cards[1] local key=first:GetAttribute('InventoryKey')
local maxY=math.max(0,grid.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-grid.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
assert(maxY>0,'inventory fixture must scroll')
grid.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.min(60,maxY))
task.wait(.15) local saved=grid.CanvasPosition.Y local selected=root:GetAttribute('InventorySelectedKey')
task.wait(1.2)
assert(first.Parent==grid and first:GetAttribute('InventoryKey')==key and math.abs(grid.CanvasPosition.Y-saved)<=1 and root:GetAttribute('InventorySelectedKey')==selected,'inventory scroll or card identity changed')
grid.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,maxY)
task.wait(.15)
assert(math.abs(grid.CanvasPosition.Y-maxY)<=1,'inventory cannot reach final row')
local result={visible=root.Visible,drawer=root:GetAttribute('InventoryDetailMode')=='Drawer',bounded=true,modal=g.GameMenu:GetAttribute('InventoryModalSizing'),layout=root:GetAttribute('InventoryMobileLayout'),columns=root:GetAttribute('InventoryColumns'),cardHeight=cards[1].AbsoluteSize.Y,viewportWidth=viewport.X,viewportHeight=viewport.Y,windowHeight=window.AbsoluteSize.Y,scrollY=grid.CanvasPosition.Y,cards=#cards}
local expectedColumns=(root:GetAttribute('InventoryAvailableGridWidth') or 0)>=600 and 2 or 1
assert(result.visible and result.drawer and result.modal=='PhoneSafeFill12V1' and result.layout=='PhoneReadableRowsV6' and result.columns==expectedColumns,'Inventory All '..H:JSONEncode(result))
return H:JSONEncode(result)
